meta.description: Exp 010: atmospheric drag / orbit decay -- dissipation accounting, decay-law rediscovery, scalings, reentry timing (declared Vallado atmosphere)
meta.name: orbit_decay

atmosphere.bias_note: declared Vallado fit runs +26..+34% above US76 across the LEO band; documented model bias folded into decade-wide smoke bands only
atmosphere.blocked_sources_note: Cook/King-Hele/Walker Proc. R. Soc. A primary texts sit behind a bot challenge - NOT accessed per lab rules
atmosphere.secondary_source_flags: King-Hele formulas cited from open secondary sources: Ray & Scheeres MNRAS 501, 1168 (2021), arXiv:2008.10644 and ASU MAE462 Lecture 12
atmosphere.source: Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications, exponential-atmosphere data file ATMOSEXP.DAT (official CelesTrak repository, retrieved 2026-08-22); LEO rows consistent with US Standard Atmosphere 1976 (NASA-TM-X-74335) to ~35%
atmosphere.us76_source: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 (NASA-TM-X-74335) via PDAS tables

starlink_storm_decay_km_day.exclusion_reason: severe-geomagnetic density augmentation outside declared quiet-model scope

constants.beta_convention: beta = m/(C_D A) [kg/m^2]; kappa = C_D A/m = 1/beta; C_D canonical 2.2 for LEO spheres (Cooke 1965)
constants.provenance: inherited from Exp 008/009 (IAU 2015 B3 GM; WGS-84 Re; WGS-84 J2; see groundtracks/j2Precession cards for full derivation chains)
constants.units: km, km^3/s^2, s; angles rad internally; density/ballistic terms SI

results.figures_note: regenerated deterministically from results.json data, dpi=150

headline.circularization: steep case apogee drop 22.3 km with perigee change 0.05 km
headline.decay_law_rediscovered: leoRef 420 km beta=100: max |a_num - a_oracle| = 3.6 m over 500 revs (-8.69e-04 rel on window time)
headline.reentry_timing: 200 km circular -> 120 km in 2.015505015920682 days; dual thresholds reported
headline.rotation_asymmetry: equatorial retro/prograde rate ratio 1.3032 vs theory 1.2946
headline.scalings: beta ratios exact to 1.7e-02; rho0 ratios to 1.7e-02

limitations: spherical geocentric altitude h=|r|-R_E; geodetic altitude differs by up to 21.4 km (pole) / 13.1 km (ISS inclination) -> external density comparisons carry up to a factor ~1.4 bias (folded into decade-wide bands)
quiet-time exponential atmosphere; geomagnetic storms, diurnal and seasonal density variations excluded (Starlink storm benchmarks recorded as context only)
lifetimes above ~350 km come from the quadrature oracle validated by numerical spot decays at 250-300 km; direct end-to-end propagation there exceeds the step budget
erfi closed form restricted to single layers with h0>=120 km (float64 overflow of exp((R_E+h0)/H) in lower layers); multi-layer windows use quadrature
King-Hele few-% checks gated to e<=0.1; large-e anchors use direct Gauss quadrature
J2 off for headline decay numbers (no secular J2-decay coupling under a spherical altitude-only atmosphere); J2 on/off equivalence null recorded instead
save_json_result rounds |x|>=1e-10 to 12 decimals; rates therefore stored in m/day
results.resolution_rule: steps_per_orbit(e): 512/orbit circular (donor special-cases e<=0), max(512, ceil(720/(1-e)^1.5)) eccentric; fixed dt per run = period/spp; reentry crossings refined by reintegrating the bracketed interval at dt/2^j (j<=6); dual thresholds 120/100 km reported

j2_settled_comparison.note: raw osculating-a slope under J2 is contaminated by the U_J2 mean-offset transient plus ripple aliasing; use energy-bookkeeping tail rates

beta_ratio_and_rho_ratio_rel_dev_max.justification: continuum-exact at fixed state; finite-window drift nonlinearity O(kappa*Delta_a/H) grows with window length: ~1.7% for the widest ratio (beta 50/100) at the frozen 250-rev windows (measured 1.7e-2)

convergence_order_min.justification: design order 4; time-to-fall observable shows pre-asymptotic SUPERCONVERGENCE (measured 3.78 then ~5.0 as leading error terms cancel before the floor); raw Kepler position-error check confirms no degradation below design order

dt_invariance_steep_rel_max.justification: contract gate before recording any steep-case number

eccentric_o4_agreement_rel_max.justification: Gauss quadrature along osculating conic vs RK4 Cowell: independent paths

equatorial_twin_rel_dev_max.justification: exact all-order theory; residual is integration asymmetry only

erfi_vs_quad_rel_max.justification: both paths far below float64 noise on a single-layer segment

j2_settled_residual_max.justification: settled-tail energy rates after altitude-shift correction; residual is second-order J2-density coupling only

king_hele_small_e_rel_dev_max.justification: King-Hele truncation O(e^2)~0.4% at e=0.05 plus layer-H discretization

leoref_quad_vs_num_rel_max.justification: order-4 integration floor at default spp (convergence study), oracle self-converged <1e-9

omega_twin_symmetry_rel_max.justification: exact frame symmetry under spherical law; floating-point rounding only

plateau_separation_min_ratio.justification: law swap must move transit time >=20x more than dt refinement
